newsitem.title: USA: Titan says to finish Ill. plant expansion.
newsitem.headline: Titan says to finish Ill. plant expansion.

text.p: Titan Wheel Corp said it will complete a multi-million dollar capacity expansion at its off-highway wheel plant in Quincy, Ill.
"The expansion was prompted by increased worldwide production demands in the agricultural market," Titan said.

The expansion includes addition of an automated welding line and a press line. Titan will also be extending its number of robotic welding cells to perform wheel assembly. Two rim lines will supplement Titan's current wheel manufacturing capabilities, the company said.
Titan said it expects further expansion programs.
